text:
I’m a passionate and hard-working machine learning freelancer with 6 years of experience, and I’d love to help your startup identify alternative data sources for stock market analysis.

My background includes Python, PyTorch, scikit-learn, LangChain, OpenAI API, Hugging Face Transformers, NLP, XGBoost, pandas, and machine learning. I can help assess which signals may be most useful for traders and investors, including sentiment data, web traffic data, volatility-related signals, flow data, and other text-based or behavioral sources.

One relevant project was Coffee review themes for Cobalt Coffee Roasters, where I built a small Streamlit app that grouped 38k marketplace reviews into themes and tracked sentiment per theme each week. That work produced 12 stable themes and replaced about 2 days a month of manual tagging.

I’d be glad to discuss how to approach alternative data discovery and prioritization for your platform.
